requirements.title: Functions invoked in expressions compute values used by expression evaluation
requirements.definition: A procedure is either a function or a subroutine; invoking a function in an expression computes a value used to evaluate that expression.

pending.procedure-kind-function-or-subroutine: Compile a function returning 69 and a subroutine assigning 70 to its dummy; main checks both exact values.
pending.function-value-used-in-expression: Function f(i) returns i+71; main evaluates 2*f(3)+1 and expects exactly 149.

requirements.title: A nonpure procedure may change accessible program state
requirements.definition: A procedure that is not pure may change program state by changing accessible data objects or procedure pointers.

pending.nonpure-data-object-change-permitted: Module variable state starts at -72; nonpure subroutine set_state assigns 72; main calls it and checks state==72.
pending.nonpure-procedure-pointer-change-permitt: Procedure pointer pp starts associated with f_old returning -73; nonpure subroutine retargets pp to f_new returning 73; main calls pp before and after and checks both exact values.
